Rule: read the forward demand ladder on the SEASON-ACTIVE degree-day axis (gw_CDD in cooling season, gw_HDD in heating season) and treat its D0/D+1 slope as a standing daily lean input - rising = partial up-lean (heat adds some), falling = larger down-lean (mild kills big; the asymmetry is doctrine, never fitted). In g22 both band-authority instruments were HDD-keyed and void-by-construction (divergence_resolution gate (a) HDD >= 16.4 unreachable in July; shoulder_weather_band_void HDD <= 13.5 trivially satisfied), leaving the blind no slope channel: the -1,815 drift IS the unexpressed hill (realized cum +470 vs blind -1,345; all four down-forecast-printed-up days 0622/0624/0630/0703 sit on rising-CDD segments; forecast-D0 CDD ramp 9.06 -> 18.87). The winter arm of this channel already exists in-brain (the cold-ramp band family, G12-G16 evidence); g22 supplies the summer arm - the proposal is ONE continuous season-symmetric channel, plus a CDD arm for both gate instruments with its band bar left UNSET until measured on cooling-season blocks (no threshold fitted from one block). Requires the declared data fix (CDD at all horizons). n: winter side >= 5 groups in-brain; summer side g22 (block-level + 4 day instances); spans groups on the mechanism, and the summer-arm bar waits for a second cooling block by design. (2) CONVERSION GATE ON THE SLOPE'S UP-LEAN (the renewable subtractor, read correctly). Rule: the slope's up-lean must pass a burn-conversion check in grid_stack - est_gas_burn_bcfd/gas_mwh rising with the ladder = converting, up-lean earned; burn flat-or-falling while CDD rises (wind/solar spike absorbing the add, nuclear returning) = NON-CONVERSION, the up-lean is void for that session and a chain-sided down day may run its band (g22 0629: burn 38.6 -> 34.4 served while forecast CDD jumped 10.08 -> 14.82, wind +660,219 MWh +62%, nuclear chg_7d -1,443; session -1,160). The chain's last delivery ran OVERNIGHT (onset 03:03, aligned ph1 -126/-280, extended to -480 by 08:59 on thin conviction), not in the post-print window. The 10:30:00 release flushed -230 in ten seconds to a MARGINAL new low (-530 at 10:30:08, just -50 under the overnight low = a stop-run into the absorber) on a print that was actually -1.4 BELOW consensus; the flush absorbed (ph2: -1,612 sold for +20 of price), the 10:39 retest held above the flush low, and the session turned there - turn_up 530 from the print tick. The recovery ran entirely on NEGATIVE conviction (ph3 -1,123 sold under +250 of price, absorb-flagged): covering into resting bids, which reclaims the absorbed excursion but does not earn new ground - the +160 extension at 15:53 faded to a dead-flat close. Magnitude decomposition, derived: absorption_is_reversal sizes the reversal at the RECLAIM span (+530, the full flush+overnight excursion - not damped, honoring the play's never-a-cap clause and my own g20_0528 declined-evidence lesson); the extension BEYOND the reclaim required an ALIGNED phase that never printed, so the day nets flat. Blind +200 -> posterior 0 (band -150..+150): the blind's gate-driven counter-tilt was RIGHT and its +200 was the day's MFE, not its close. WINDOW AUDIT, plainly: my blind window assignment was WRONG. (1) Overnight: claimed +40 (18Z-MAV-warmer token), realized -480 - wrong sign, and the lesson is that a 0.74-gw model spread cannot own a seam against an unfinished chain residual. (2) Pre-print 08:00-10:30: claimed near-zero net; realized net -50 but two-way (-480->-140->-530) - net right, but only because my window DEFINITION excluded the overnight where the mass actually ran; my stated falsifier named 08:00-10:30 and so never fired while the decomposition failed anyway - the falsifier window was drawn too narrow, reopen->print is the honest window. (3) Print delivery 10:30-12:00: claimed chain-sided DOWN -170; realized UP +470 off the low - wrong sign; the chain-sided leg I placed inside the print window had ALREADY happened before it. (4) Post-print digestion: claimed +300 recovery to a close-at-high +160; realized +690 low-to-high with my +160 close exactly equal to the realized 15:53 HIGH excursion - right leg, over-held into the close; the ph3 absorption verdict is what I lacked. reasoning.proposal_contribution: P1 (EIA window doctrine - extends daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate + the D lens; general, n=4 spanning g17/g22): the EIA pre-print window is REOPEN->10:30, never 08:00->10:30. When the gate fires (>=2 limbs), the chain's final delivery tends to run in the OVERNIGHT/early-morning seam and EXHAUST AT the print: the print's first impulse runs the stops to a MARGINAL new extreme (within ~1 tick-cluster of the overnight extreme), and delivery-vs-absorption in the first minutes decides the session - absorbed flush = the turn (turn_et at/within minutes of 10:30), and the post-print leg belongs to the COUNTER side. Instances: 0702/g22 (overnight -480 chain-aligned, flush to -530 at 10:30:08 on a hair-bullish print, absorbed, +690 counter-leg); 0625/g22 (mirror: pre-print +850 high 09:01, post-print low 10:48, round-trip to -40); 0416/g17 and 0430/g17 (the gate's founding cascade pair: bleed into print, print rallies counter). Consequences: (a) blind falsifier/timing windows on print days must bind the FULL reopen->print stretch - my 0702 falsifier named 08:00-10:30, never fired, and the decomposition failed anyway in the overnight; (b) when the gate fires, assign the chain's residual delivery to the OVERNIGHT window and give the post-print window to the counter side - I did the exact opposite windowing blind (+40 overnight, chain-sided print leg) and both were wrong-signed; (c) sharpening for magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort: on exhaustion-class prints (gate >=2) the Thursday up-size prior applies to RANGE/two-way travel, NOT to net - 0702 delivered 1,380 of leg travel and a 0 net; 0625 delivered 1,350 of range and -40. P2 (covering-quality cap = the S109 asymmetric slope's up-side made mechanical; general, spanning g18/g22): summer-hill UP-legs are covering-financed and self-capping. The G18 doctrine key already records the discriminator (covering-absorbed UP vs aligned-delivered DOWN, the block the price-walled blind missed); G22 week 2 repeats it at day scale: every up-leg in the hill's crest week ran NEGATIVE total signed flow with absorb flags (0630 +790 on -5,573 absorb; 0702's +530 reclaim on ph2/ph3 absorb, closed 0; 0703 +410 on -1,005 absorb) while week-1 up-days ran positive flow (0624 +311, 0626 +871). Rule: when an up-leg's conviction is NEGATIVE (rising price on net sell flow), it is the 'up, but only SOME' arm of the asymmetric-slope doctrine - size it at the RECLAIM of the absorbed excursion (absorption_is_reversal's reversal span, full credit, never damped) and DENY the extension beyond the reclaim unless an ALIGNED phase prints; expect extensions to round-trip (0702's +160 high -> 0 close; the 0326-class lens read). This also resolves the apparent tension between absorption_is_reversal ('never a cap') and the shared round-trip clause: the reversal-reclaim gets full size, the post-reclaim EXTENSION is what covering cannot hold. P3 (renewable subtractor two-way check - grid_stack components; n=2 within g22 on a feed born S99, scope-flagged pending a cross-group instance): a CDD-slope up-lean must pass the component check - wind_mwh d/d and est_gas_burn_bcfd d/d must not contradict the weather-implied burn. 0629: wind +62% / burn -4.2 Bcfd VETOES the heat-add for the session (the directive's named unread subtractor - CDD arrived as forecast and gas burn fell); 0702: wind -8% off peak / burn +2.4 to block max CONFIRMS it (and the day's causal turn was absorption at the print, subtractor-consistent).
